name: Log Volume and Self-Review Analysis
description: Analyze system logs and self-review recommendations to diagnose issues, register support tickets, and update the knowledge base.

steps.name: Read System Logs & Telemetry
steps.action: Load recent console logs and activity event telemetry from the ActivityBus log entries.

steps.name: Evaluate Failures & Latencies
steps.action: Analyze failures, latencies, and self-review recommendations to identify issues or configuration drift.

steps.name: Triage & Log Support Tickets
steps.action: Update status, raise support desk tickets for any detected critical failures, and trigger remedial actions.

steps.name: Update Self-Review Knowledge Base
steps.action: Persist review diagnostics report to the self-review knowledge base and update system heuristics.
